final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) FROM type_counts) AS share FROM type_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.transaction_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
